feeds.title: EnvJustice
feeds.description: EnvJustice is a research project to study and contribute to the Global Environmental Justice Movement. We keep expanding the world's largest database of environmental conflicts to study and help the global environmental justice movement.

feeds.title: Mongabay » Environmental Justice
feeds.description: Find news and insights on environmental justice, emerging trends and more in this section. Mongabay is a nonprofit media organization that provides news and information on tropical forests, wildlife, and environmental science.

feeds.title: Faith in Place Blog
feeds.description: Check out environmental news and stories on our blog. Faith in Place empowers Illinois people of all faiths to be leaders in caring for the Earth through education, connection, and advocacy.

feeds.title: Department of Environmental Quality Oregon » Environmental Justice
feeds.description: Explore this section for stories of environmental justice taken by Oregon state government. The Oregon Department of Environmental Quality is dedicated to bringing you the most up-to-date information about its efforts to protect Oregon's air, land and water.

feeds.title: CARB Environmental Justice Blog
feeds.description: CARB is committed to prioritizing environmental justice in everything that we do. This is supported by engaging with community members to provide them with the best possible information about the air they breathe and working with them to improve air quality in their communities. CARB is committed to racial equity and environmental justice as a fundamental part of all it does, including programs that reduce exposure to pollutants and improve the quality of life in California communities facing environmental and economic challenges.

feeds.title: Dr Robert Bullard
feeds.description: Read articles by Dr. Robert Bullard about environmental justice and how to face it. Dr. Robert Bullard is an Educator, researcher, policy analyst, and award-winning author. Helped develop and grow the Environmental Justice Movement. Co-chair of the National Black Environmental Network (NBEJN). Served as an expert witness and testified on hundreds of environmental and civil rights lawsuits and public hearings over the past three decades, including testimony in the U.S. Congressional hearings.

feeds.title: Literacy for Environmental Justice Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Literacy for Environmental Justice (LEJ) is to foster an understanding of the principles of environmental justice and urban sustainability in our young people in order to promote the long-term health of our communities.

feeds.title: DEOHS Blog » Environmental Justice
feeds.description: Read stories from DEOHS about environmental justice, initiatives, movements and more! The Department of Environmental & Occupational Health Sciences at the University of Washington is part of the top-ranked School of Public Health.

feeds.title: Environmental Health Coalition
feeds.description: Get news and updates from EHC along with information about environmental issues, initiatives and movements taken and more! Environmental Health Coalition (EHC) builds grassroots campaigns to confront the unjust consequences of toxic pollution, discriminatory land use, and unsustainable energy policies.
